ns2:course.label: Topics in Actuarial Theory II
ns2:course.description: Topics in mathematical theory of actuarial science beyond basic life contingencies, such as graduation of mortality tables, survival models, mathematics of demography. See Class Schedule or department office for current topics. A paper will generally be required. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: STAT 409 or STAT 410 or equivalent; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 471.
